sources.title: Do you need a visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry's live nationality list and public Livewire update route returned reproducible selected-country results for 136 previously pending ordinary-passport nationalities.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa for foreign citizens: Not needed

policies.title: North Macedonia: additional visa-free ordinary-passport nationalities
policies.summary: North Macedonia's live Foreign Ministry nationality checker returns Not needed for these 29 previously unsupported ordinary-passport relationships.
conditions: Applies to the nationality-wide ordinary short-visit baseline shown by the current Foreign Ministry checker.
Purpose, duration, travel-document class and final border admission can change the applicable treatment.
The checker gives no stay duration for these selected-country results, so no allowed-stay value is inferred.

policies.title: North Macedonia: additional visa-required ordinary-passport nationalities
policies.summary: North Macedonia's live Foreign Ministry nationality checker returns Needed for these 107 previously unsupported ordinary-passport relationships.
conditions: Applies to the nationality-wide ordinary short-visit baseline shown by the current Foreign Ministry checker.
A qualifying EU or Schengen residence document or qualifying multiple-entry Schengen, British, United States or Canadian visa may create a separate conditional exemption in 2026.
Diplomatic, official, service, special-document, work, residence and final-admission treatment are outside this policy.

unresolved.reason: The current official nationality checker has no Hong Kong entry, so it supplies no selected-country baseline for an HKSAR ordinary passport. Omission is not treated as a visa requirement.
